title: Society or school
intro: Enter your own details. No names are needed. Facts are shown only where a published factor backs them.
outdoorStaff: Guards, sweepers and other outdoor staff
vehicles: Vehicles waiting at the gate a day
idleMinutes: Minutes each waits with the engine on
needed: Fields marked needed must be filled in. Every other field is optional.

errors.homes: Enter the number of homes, from 1 to 10000.
errors.pupils: Enter the number of pupils, from 1 to 20000.
errors.children: Enter a number from 0 to 20000, or leave it blank.
errors.olderAdults: Enter a number from 0 to 20000, or leave it blank.
errors.outdoorStaff: Enter a number from 0 to 2000, or leave it blank.
errors.kva: Enter a size above 0 and up to 5000, or leave it blank.
errors.vehicles: Enter a number from 0 to 20000, or leave it blank.
errors.idleMinutes: Enter the minutes each vehicle waits, from 0 to 120.
errors.assembly: Enter a time such as 07:45, or leave it blank.
errors.periods: Give each period a start time and from 5 to 240 minutes.

busy: Working out the facts and the notice
ready: The facts and the notice are ready.
copyFailed: Copy did not work here. Select the notice text and copy it.
noHindi: This notice came without a Hindi version.
stampNote: Numbers come from the facts above, worked out in code.
photocopy: Each notice prints alone on one sheet, in black and white.
